name: print-social-instagram-feed-on-chair-mockup-pink-black
title: Pink and black Instagram feed shown on a phone standing on a woven armchair
whatItIs: A wide image with a small phone standing upright on the seat of a woven grey armchair in soft light, its screen showing a profile grid of black and pink posts. A thin brown rounded border frames it on cream.
whatItMeans: Quiet and stylish; the big neutral textile makes the tiny colourful feed stand out.
techniques: Set the phone small in a large neutral scene so the colour feed pops.
Use textured fabric and soft light for a premium look.
Show the whole grid on the profile page rather than one post.
Frame with a thin rounded border.

vocabulary.definition: A tiny device in a large calm scene.
A fabric texture used as a background.
The mosaic of posts on a profile.
A rounded border that crops an image as a tile.
